Bridge Web is hidden on Android Auto
Installing this update reset the install source, so Android Auto will not show Bridge Web until it is set again. It takes one tap with Shizuku.
• Duo Screen: Send log now says whether each pane got a trusted display (it survives the phone\'s power button) or an untrusted one, and why a trusted one could not be made.
• Send log now records how hot the phone and its battery get during a car session (every minute, plus a summary when it ends), so a long drive that overheats the phone can be seen.
• Car browser: the menu\'s \"Navigate in Google Maps\" now also appears when a Maps page is open full screen, not only in the split.
• Duo Screen: the log now also records the drags, flings and pinches your car sends, so Send log shows whether a head unit delivers them at all.

• Duo Screen: the zone where a tap grabs the seam between two panes (Edit layout) is wider, so a fingertip on the car screen hits it more easily.\n• Duo Screen: every tap from the car is now written to the log with where it went and whether it reached the pane, so Send log shows why a touch did nothing.

• Duo Screen: a shortcut for a stacked split, Google Maps on top (60 percent) and a music app below (40 percent): Settings > Duo Screen, first row. It is also a new layout in the layout chips and in the car\'s layout button.\n• Until you pick a layout, Duo Screen now starts stacked (top and bottom) on a square or tall area like a portrait head unit\'s, and side by side on a wide one.
• Send log now records what the browser was doing when the car took its screen away (playing or not, audio focus), to track down music that stops when you open the Android Auto menu.

• New under Utilities (Settings, and More on the car): Emergency card (numbers to ring, tap to dial from the car), Parking spot (mark where you parked and navigate back), Car costs (fuel and other expenses by month) and Break reminder (off by default).
• Fuel log by voice: say "เติม 40 ลิตร 1,400 บาท" (or kWh for an EV) to the Agent on the car or the phone; a mis-heard entry is fixed with Edit.
• Marking a maintenance item done can add its cost to the monthly costs.
• Parking spot can also hold a photo (of the floor sign or the pillar number) that you can view and delete.

• The video warning now comes back every three months (and whenever its wording changes), so it is a reminder, not a one-off. You will see it once more after this update.\n• The app now writes which screens Android can see to the log (Settings > Send log), to find out whether a head unit with a rear screen exposes it.
• About has a link to the Facebook page.\n• The video warning now says what is true: AutoBridge does not block playback while the car is moving, so watching only when parked is up to you.

• YouTube SponsorBlock: a note under the switch now says plainly that it may not work or may be incomplete, and why.
• Home has a coffee button for supporting the developer (not in the Play-store build).
• Maintenance suggestions now include the compulsory insurance (Por.Ror.Bor.). If you already added the suggested items, tap Add suggested again to get it.
• The fuel log, maintenance and backup now sit together under Utilities in Settings, and the fuel log and maintenance under Utilities in the car's More menu.
• Fuel log: every fill-up has a date (today unless you change it) and any past one can be edited, so a missed fill-up can be entered on its own day.
• Streaming: added Tencent Video, WeTV, iQIYI, Youku, Mango TV, CCTV, Douyin and Xiaohongshu (some may not play, or may be limited by region), and a Favorites list at the top: tap the star on any site, or add any website yourself. On the car, Manage favorites adds or removes them. The Streaming page is now an icon grid, on the phone and on the car.

• Navigating from a map in the browser: the Start and Open app buttons on the Google Maps page now start navigation in the Google Maps app (they did nothing before), and if location is switched off on the phone the app says so instead of leaving the map unable to find you.\n• Maintenance now shows the date each item falls due (or about when, from your usual driving), lets you set a due date such as when the road tax runs out, and sends a notification when something is due or close.
• Fuel log: choose the fuel grade for each fill-up (Gasohol 95, 91, E20, E85, Benzine 95, Diesel, Premium diesel, LPG, NGV) or type your own. The last grade is offered again, and it is in the CSV.
• Backup: Settings > Backup and restore saves the fuel or charging log and maintenance as one file, to move to another phone.

• EV support: switch the fuel log to EV (⚡) in Settings > Fuel log. It then counts kWh and km/kWh, and shows the battery level from the car where the car reports it.\n• Maintenance: Settings > Maintenance tracks oil, tyres, road tax and, for an EV, the coolant and 12 V battery, by distance and by date. The car shows what is due under More > Maintenance.

• Fuel log: Settings > Fuel log records each fill-up and works out km/L, baht/km and this month\'s spend. On the car: More > Fuel log; allow the car\'s odometer there and it is filled in for you at the next fill-up.\n• Duo Screen: the apps in the panes start fresh each time instead of coming back as they were left.

• The mirror is inside Bridge Web (menu > Mirror phone screen), and Bridge Mirror's own icon is off by default, so Android Auto can put Bridge Web beside Maps again.
• A split in Bridge Web no longer splits the web screen in AutoBridge.
• Settings > Send log shares a log file for reporting problems.
• Update: the APK downloads in the app and opens in the installer you pick (e.g. KingInstaller).
• The version is shown on Home.
• "Open Google Maps app? → Continue" on the split map now starts navigation in Google Maps.

• Switching TV channels no longer shows the old channel while the new one loads.
• TV: favourites and recent channels on top, next/previous on the steering wheel changes channel, unresponsive channels are hidden.
• Split screen stacks top/bottom on a portrait display; "Show on side" and "Navigate" in the menu.
• The car's search box no longer sticks over Bridge Web.
• Bridge Web keeps playing while Maps is on screen.\n• "Start" on the split map hands the destination to Google Maps.

• Car keyboard opens on a page\'s search box and closes after searching.\n• Rewinding no longer silences the song; Bridge Web gets the split screen; the phone shows "connected" whatever is on the car.

AutoBridge
 Developed by Guitar (Arnuwat Tiamrat), Thailand.

Built with these open-source and third-party components:

• AndroidX & Jetpack Compose — Google (Apache-2.0)
• AndroidX Car App Library — Google (Apache-2.0)
• Media3 / ExoPlayer — Google (Apache-2.0)
• Kotlin & kotlinx.coroutines — JetBrains (Apache-2.0)
• Shizuku API — RikkaApps (Apache-2.0)
• ML Kit Translate — Google
• ONNX Runtime — Microsoft (MIT), with Opus-MT (Marian) models by the Language Technology Research Group, University of Helsinki (CC-BY-4.0)
• AndroidX WebKit, Browser (Custom Tabs) — Google (Apache-2.0)
• Play Services OSS Licenses — Google

Data & content sources:
• Weather by Open-Meteo (CC-BY-4.0), no API key
• SponsorBlock community data for YouTube segment skipping
• IPTV / streaming links are user-provided; AutoBridge hosts no content

Inspiration & references (GPL-3.0):
• Fermata Media Player — Andrey Pavlenko · github.com/AndreyPavlenko/Fermata
• Fermata-Xtream — malebuffy · github.com/malebuffy/Fermata-Xtream
• AABrowser — kododake · github.com/kododake/AABrowser

AutoBridge uses Android's accessibility service as a remote control for this phone.

When the phone screen is shown on the car display, this is what turns a tap on the car screen into a tap on the phone: the service performs the taps, swipes and Back/Home actions for you. Without it the car display can show the phone but cannot control it.

It is told about window changes only — it does not read the text on your screen, and it never passes anything on. Everything stays on this phone.

The next screen is Android's own accessibility settings. You can turn the service off there at any time.
Use the microphone for voice commands?

The Agent screen listens while you hold the mic, turns what you said into text, and runs it as a command — "open YouTube", "resume", "play the radio".

It records only during a listen session, the car microphone when the car has one and this phone's otherwise. The speech recognition is Android's own, the same one keyboard dictation uses. AutoBridge keeps no recording and sends nothing to its own servers.

Android will now ask for microphone permission on your phone.
Use the phone\'s GPS when the car reports no speed
Use GPS for the speed reading?

AutoBridge needs a speed to know whether the car is parked, and some head units never report one. With this on, the phone's GPS fills that gap: the app reads the speed from the location fix while a car session is running.

The location is used for that number alone. It is not stored, not logged and not sent anywhere, and nothing is read while the app is not connected to a car.

Leave this off and AutoBridge uses the car's own speed signal only.
